The Global Stage for Building Products: The 2027 A+Product Awards Are Now Open

Over 30 categories spanning façades, glazing, lighting, acoustics, furniture and smart design, with judging led by architects from the world’s most recognized practices.

Architizer Editors
  • Updates
  • Awards, Product Awards
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 4:44
Instaread

The best products are made by people, for people. In an era of automation and mass production, the ones that stand out keep human experience at their center, on both sides of the making. The Architizer A+Product Awards honor products that embody this, from finely engineered glazing systems and bespoke furniture to hand-finished surfaces, adaptable systems and custom-milled materials.

Judged by the designers actively specifying, the program recognizes brands blending technical excellence with design integrity, where innovation meets the hand of the maker, and where good design is measured by how well it serves the people who use it.

Do you make building products, lighting, materials or furniture that put people at the center, are designed with care and are made to improve how we experience the built environment? Architizer — in partnership with material sourcing innovator Material Bank — invites manufacturers from around the world to enter.

Enter before the Main Entry Deadline on December 4th, 2026, before the pricing goes up. Click below to get started:

Start Submission

Why the A+Product Awards Are a Must for Your Brand

A sample of last season’s A+Product Winners: Éclos by Cosentino Group; Tilt + Shift by David Rockwell for Stackabl by Rockwell Group; Automist – smart fire sprinkler alternative by Plumis; MAGIC™ (Modular Acoustic Greenery + Illumination Collection) by CSI Creative; ‘Open Sesame’ Desk by Lia Siqueira Design; Hejduk Lamp by Lr Design; Ranchers Ridge from Eldorado Stone by Westlake Royal Building Products; Acoustic Ceiling Panels \ Batten by TerraMai.

The A+Product Awards put your products on a global stage, reviewed by an esteemed jury of top-tier architects and designers from internationally acclaimed firms. Recent jurors have included leaders from practices such as Foster + Partners, Gensler, HDR, Olson Kundig and Kohn Pedersen Fox, each selecting their top choices against rigorous criteria of aesthetics, performance and impact- the qualities that make a product stand out in architecture and design.

An A+Product Award is more than a trophy. It’s validation from the architects who specify these products every day, which means your brand is seen by the professionals who matter most.

Enter the A+Product Awards

A Category for Every Product

Whatever your company specializes in, there’s a category for it. The A+Product Awards offer more than 30 categories spanning every essential component of architecture and interior design:

  • Façades, Cladding and Roofing
  • Doors, Windows and Glazing
  • Acoustic Products, Ceilings and Flooring
  • Architectural and Decorative Lighting
  • Bath and Kitchen Products
  • Contract, Residential and Outdoor Furniture
  • Smart Design and AEC Technology

Above these, the Best of the Year categories honor products at the top of their class, with recognition for Sustainable Design, Innovation, Positive Impact and more. Entering across several categories widens your brand’s chances. For the full guide to this year’s categories, click here.

Year-Round Recognition and Visibility

As well as those top architects on the jury, the A+Product Awards present a powerful opportunity for you to showcase your products to specifiers around the world. Gain worldwide exposure via Architizer’s online community of 4.5+ million architects and designers: speaking event possibilities, networking opportunities and editorial spotlights are made available to select winning brands, extending the value of your A+Product Award long into the future.

Winners will be considered for coverage in a special edition of METROPOLIS, a nationally distributed magazine, as well as several feature articles on Architonic. Winners will also be invited to a special in-person networking event in 2027.

Submit a Product

Become an AEC Industry Leader

A sample of last season’s A+Product Winners: MAGIC™ by CSI Creative; BLANC PRO by META elements; Disco-Rectangle by Infinity Drain; Dotti by KFI studios; Maru Pendant Kakishibu by Cedar & Moss; The Classic Collection by Essem Design; TERRAE x AMDL CIRCLE by Mirage Granito Ceramico Spa; Piccoli Collection by Tile Bar; James Desk by Rottet Collection.

Winning an A+Product Award puts your product in front of the design world’s most influential figures. With exposure to Architizer’s audience of more than seven million architects and designers, winners gain:

  • Worldwide reach across a community of 4.5M+ architects and designers
  • A year-round marketing package worth more than $20,000
  • A place in the annual A+Product List editorial feature, distributed to 17,000+ member firms

In addition, winners receive an iconic engraved A+Product Awards trophy and a featured placement in Architizer’s Winners’ Gallery — perfect for display at trade shows, in showrooms or across your marketing campaigns.

Apply for Global Recognition

Secure Your Place on the A+Product List

This year, the world’s top brands will compete to gain or hold a place on the A+Product List, the definitive directory of world-class building product designers. The list lives year-round on Architizer.com and is refreshed annually, giving architects a trusted specification resource and giving top brands continual visibility.

The A+Product List will be shared with 4.5M+ architects, designers and creative clients through the Architizer newsletter and social channels.

Connect with the World’s Best Architects and Designers

A sample of last season’s A+Product Winners: Gendai® and Sugi Weathering Stain Silver by Nakamoto Forestry;  Amari by RitikaaWood; Solskin by Zurich Soft Robotics GmbH; Somari by LightArt; Block by Sabin; Tumble by KFI studios; Transitions by Jill Malek; Bézier Sofa by studio mk27 

Beyond the architects on the jury, the A+Product Awards open a direct line to specifiers around the world. Speaking events, networking and editorial spotlights are made available to select winning brands, extending the value of an A+Product Award long after the season ends. Shortlisted brands also gain access to exclusive paid media opportunities.

For more on categories, deadlines, fees and eligibility, visit the program page or contact us at productawards@architizer.com.

We can’t wait to see your products in the spotlight.

Start Submission

35 Best Architecture and Design Firms in New York

New York City is arguably the epicenter of the architecture industry in the U.S. These are the city’s top firms.

Architizer Editors
  • Collections
  • Top Firms

These annual rankings were last updated on October 23, 2026. Want to see your firm on next year’s list? Continue reading for more on how you can improve your studio’s ranking.

New York is arguably the epicenter of the architectural industry in the United States, with more than 20,000 licensed architects and well over 1,000 firms working in the state. At its heart, New York City (NYC) is home to a thriving community of architects, interior designers, landscape architects, engineers and contractors, with projects ranging from residential and retail to cultural and commercial. Construction firms generated an estimated $84 billion in economic activity in 2018, representing 10 percent of New York City’s total economic output.

With so many architecture firms to choose from, it’s challenging for clients to identify the industry leaders that will be an ideal fit for their project needs. Fortunately, Architizer is able to provide guidance on the top design firms in New York, United States, based on more than a decade of data and industry knowledge.

How are these architecture firms ranked?

The following ranking has been created according to key statistics that demonstrate each firm’s level of architectural excellence. The following metrics have been accumulated to establish each architecture firm’s ranking, in order of priority:

  • The number of A+Awards won (2013 to 2026)
  • The number of A+Awards finalists (2013 to 2026)
  • The number of projects selected as “Project of the Day” (2009 to 2026)
  • The number of projects selected as “Featured Project” (2009 to 2026)
  • The number of projects uploaded to Architizer (2009 to 2026)

Each of these metrics is explained in more detail at the foot of this article. This ranking list will be updated annually, taking into account new achievements of New York architecture firms throughout the year.

Without further ado, here are the 35 best architecture firms in New York:

© Martha Schwartz Partners

Situated at the intersection of landscape, art, and urbanism, Martha Schwartz Partners is committed to the design of urban landscapes and the public realm as the foundation for sustainable cities that are healthy across all aspects and sectors of urban life.

Some of Martha Schwartz Partners’ most prominent projects include:

  • Beiqijia Technology Business (BTB) District, Beijing, China
  • Zigong Dongxingsi Precinct Riverfront Park, Zigong, China
  • Vilnius Plaza, Vilnius, Lithuania
  • Fengming Mountain Park, China
  • Sowwah Square, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates

Over the last ten years, THEVERYMANY has developed and implemented “Structural Stripes,” a building system by which custom-designed parts form complex, self-supporting curvilinear surfaces.

Why Should I Trust Architizer’s Ranking?

With more than 30,000 architecture firms and over 130,000 projects within its database, Architizer is proud to host the world’s largest online community of architects and building product manufacturers. Its celebrated A+Awards program is also the largest celebration of architecture and building products, with more than 400 jurors and hundreds of thousands of public votes helping to recognize the world’s best architecture each year.

Architizer also powers firm directories for a number of AIA (American Institute of Architects) Chapters nationwide, including the official directory of architecture firms for AIA New York.

An example of a project page on Architizer with Project Award Badges highlighted

A Guide to Project Awards

The blue “+” badge denotes that a project has won a prestigious A+Award as described above. Hovering over the badge reveals details of the award, including award category, year, and whether the project won the jury or popular choice award.

The orange Project of the Day and yellow Featured Project badges are awarded by Architizer’s Editorial team, and are selected based on a number of factors. The following factors increase a project’s likelihood of being featured or awarded Project of the Day status:

  • Project completed within the last 3 years
  • A well written, concise project description of at least 3 paragraphs
  • Architectural design with a high level of both functional and aesthetic value
  • High quality, in focus photographs
  • At least 8 photographs of both the interior and exterior of the building
  • Inclusion of architectural drawings and renderings
  • Inclusion of construction photographs

There are 7 Projects of the Day each week and a further 31 Featured Projects. Each Project of the Day is published on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram Stories, while each Featured Project is published on Facebook. Each Project of the Day also features in Architizer’s Weekly Projects Newsletter and shared with 170,000 subscribers.

 

 

We’re constantly look for the world’s best architects to join our community. If you would like to understand more about this ranking list and learn how your firm can achieve a presence on it, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at editorial@architizer.com.
